abstract: Operating guide for Bifrost (maximhq/bifrost) gateway v2.2.6: npx and Docker install with storage options, config.json and provider setup, auth with a setup token, virtual keys with hierarchical budgets and rate limits, per-provider retries and per-request fallbacks, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and semantic cache, SDK and Claude Code drop-ins, LiteLLM migration, updating, teardown and troubleshooting. Confirmed maintained (not archived, release 2026-10-06) before writing.
